description: Deviation of the benchmark judge calls from the official GraphRAG-Bench evaluator. The unmodified evaluator is pointed at a local proxy that applies exactly this policy to every judge request, for BOTH systems.
embedding_note: Replaces the evaluator local BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 for the semantic-similarity term of Answer Correctness (researcher decision 2026-11-24). Project-consistent but a deviation from the official evaluator.
omit_reason: The official evaluator always sends temperature=0.0. A 2026-11-24 live probe showed gpt-6-luna rejects temperature=0.0 with its default reasoning configuration (400 unsupported_value, only the default 1 is supported). Reasoning effort is deliberately NOT changed to accommodate it.
unchanged_parameters_note: All other parameters the evaluator sends (for example top_p=1, seed=42, presence_penalty=0, frequency_penalty=0, model, messages) are forwarded unchanged. Their acceptance by gpt-6-luna has NOT been verified; if the API rejects any, requests fail visibly in the ledger and the policy must be revised deliberately, never silently.
